question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Teelotaler.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **'Teelotaler.'**
 
• The correct spelling is **"Teetotaller."**
 
• "T**eetotaller"** means a person who does not drink alcohol. (कभी भी मदिरापान न करने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• Example: *He himself was a non-smoking **teetotaler**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Unanimously: **without opposition; with the agreement of all people involved. (एकमत होकर, सर्वसम्‍मति से)
 
• **Contagious: **(used about a disease) that you can get by touching somebody/something. ((रोग) संपर्क या स्‍पर्श द्वारा फैलने वाला; संसर्गज)
 
• **Irreparable: **that cannot be repaired. (जिस क्षति की पूर्ति न हो सके, जिस स्थिति को सुधारा न जा सके; असुधार्य)
